description: Epoch AI 'AI Chip Sales' dataset — AI chip sales/shipment timelines by chip type and designer.

body.how_to_read: chip_types and organizations are reference tables; the timelines files are time series of cumulative chip sales overall, by designer, and by chip. Read each CSV header for exact columns. Relevant to chip-volume / designer-mix signals.

methodology.summary: As-downloaded Epoch AI 'AI Chip Sales' export, cleaned by the epoch_ai ingest, copied to blobs on 2026-06-12. Confidence 0.8 (curated CC BY 4.0 dataset).
